title: Custom Label Heat Shrink Tubing — What label heat shrink is
description: Printable heat shrink tubing is wire sleeving you print a label on, slide over a connection, and shrink with heat — the text becomes a permanent ring around the wire. It organizes wiring harnesses by giving every wire a name it cannot lose.

title: Custom Label Heat Shrink Tubing — Shrink ratios
description: The ratio — 2:1, 3:1, 4:1 — says how much the diameter shrinks: 3:1 tubing at 9 mm recovers to 3 mm. Higher ratios fit over chunky connectors and still grip thin wires.

title: Custom Label Heat Shrink Tubing — Picking the diameter
description: Pick tubing whose supplied diameter clears the largest thing it slides over and whose recovered diameter grips the wire: the connector must pass, the wire must be hugged. When in doubt between two sizes, take the larger ratio, not the larger tube.
